purpose: Deterministic Installation-Space and Tactical-Power sanity checks for the completed TL3 base candidate row. These arithmetic checks do not activate TL3 runtime mechanics or promote balance.

architectures.interpretation: first becomes a credible complete outlier at TL3 because 3 discretionary Space can fit one Shield Generator or a focused 2-Space PDS + 1-Space support choice
TL3 compact fusion makes dual-reactor resilience/power a practical outlier while preserving substantial Space cost
remains illegal by 2 Space at TL3; no special prohibition required

representativeTl3Builds.note: Uses 2-Space standing PDS footprint; magazine expansions are separate optional support.

dualEnergySingleReactor.package: two Standard Energy shots + High Active Sensor
two Standard Energy shots + Low Active Sensor
two High Energy shots + High Active Sensor

power.interpretation: Six TP does not make all installed TL3 systems free to operate simultaneously. A dual-main single-reactor ship can fire both mains when family/mode costs permit, but support/EW/defense options compete directly for the remaining pool. Power insufficiency remains operational tradeoff, not construction illegality.

guardrails: Do not convert the outlier status into a one-reactor-per-weapon rule.
Do not increase TL3 reactor output merely to power every installed system.
Do not shrink TL3 Main Weapons or STL/FTL drives in this base pass; those are future progression levers.
Keep dual-main/dual-reactor illegality emergent from Space arithmetic rather than a special class restriction.
